name: arm_length
label: Arm length
description: Length of each of the two arms between pivots; the spring anchors follow

name: shade_diameter
label: Shade diameter
description: Diameter of the shade's rim; the spring anchors follow its weight

name: base_turn
label: Base turn
description: Where the lamp is swivelled on its base, by hand

name: lower_load_moment
expr: gravity * (elbow_mass * arm_length + bar_mass * arm_length + lower_spring_share_mass * lower_reach)

name: lower_angle
expr: lower_mid_angle + lower_amplitude * cos(360 deg * t + lower_phase)

name: upper_angle
expr: upper_mid_angle + upper_amplitude * cos(360 deg * t + upper_phase)

name: lower_anchor_measured
expr: lower_reach * cos(lower_lean) + if(lower_anchor_height > lower_reach * cos(lower_lean), 1, -1) * sqrt(max(lower_span_solved^2 - lower_reach^2 * sin(lower_lean)^2, 0 mm^2))
label: Lower anchor height, from the solved span

name: upper_anchor_measured
expr: upper_reach * cos(upper_lean) + if(upper_anchor_height > upper_reach * cos(upper_lean), 1, -1) * sqrt(max(upper_span_solved^2 - upper_reach^2 * sin(upper_lean)^2, 0 mm^2))
label: Upper anchor height, from the solved span

name: lower_gravity_torque
expr: gravity * sin(lower_lean) * (lower_bars_mass * arm_length / 2 + elbow_group_mass * arm_length + lower_spring_group_mass / 2 * lower_reach)
label: Gravity torque on the lower arm

name: upper_gravity_torque
expr: gravity * sin(upper_lean) * (upper_bars_mass * arm_length / 2 + head_group_mass * arm_length + upper_spring_group_mass / 2 * upper_reach)
label: Gravity torque on the upper arm

name: lower_spring_torque
expr: springs_per_arm * lower_spring_force * lower_reach * lower_anchor_measured * sin(lower_lean) / lower_span_solved
label: Spring torque on the lower arm

name: upper_spring_torque
expr: springs_per_arm * upper_spring_force * upper_reach * upper_anchor_measured * sin(upper_lean) / upper_span_solved
label: Spring torque on the upper arm

name: lower_net_torque
label: Net torque about the lower pivots

name: upper_net_torque
label: Net torque about the upper pivots

title: Spring-balanced task lamp
description: A two-arm desk lamp balanced by four extension springs: oak parallelogram arms, brass elbows, a cast-iron base, a spun-steel shade on a ball joint. The net torque about each arm's pivot, from the measured masses and the real springs, stays within a stated pivot friction over a sweep of poses.
author: 3DCraft assemblies
